reviews.author: dhivya ramalingam
reviews.text:
The first time we met Dr. Aishwarya Parthasarathy, we were immediately struck by her warmth and expertise. From day one, she gave us hope, comfort, and reassurance—more than just a doctor, she felt like a sister guiding us through every challenge. Thanks to her, we now hold our tiny little baby girl in our arms, a dream come true for us. Despite her packed schedule, she was always just a call away, ready to listen, understand our concerns, and ensure we felt at ease. Her immense knowledge and dedication made all the difference in our journey, and we can’t thank her enough for the care and support she provided.

Dr. Ashwin Muralidharan is an amazing radiologist who played such a crucial role in our journey. He took the time to be with us through every scan, paying attention to every little detail. Those moments, seeing our baby on the screen, were pure bliss—we found ourselves eagerly waiting for each scan, falling more and more in love with our little one. What truly stood out was how he made sure both of us were involved, calling in the partner for every scan and patiently explaining everything in detail.

AccuMed Speciality and Scans is truly a one-stop place for everything we needed. Their team is incredibly supportive, always available over a call, and ready to help at any time. A special thanks to the amazing nursing staff—Ms. Sharmi, Ms. Anu, Mrs. Uma Ragul, Ms. Ashwini, and Ms. Mathu—who were with us every step of the way. The best part? They value patients’ time and ensure that everything—scans, reports, and consultations—gets done in a single visit. This was a huge relief for us as we juggled work and pregnancy. With a mini lab, skilled technicians, and a fully stocked pharmacy, we never had to step out for anything—it was all right there.

A heartfelt thank you to Dr. Aishwarya, Dr. Ashwin, and the entire ASCAS team for making this journey so smooth and giving us memories to cherish for a lifetime!

reviews.author: Sonia Eswari V
reviews.text:
We are incredibly grateful to Dr. Aishwarya Parthasarathy for making our dream of becoming parents a reality within just 1.5 years of marriage. I had a few large myomas, which she skillfully removed through laparoscopic myomectomy. Following the surgery, she encouraged us to try for natural conception, but due to personal circumstances, including my husband’s imminent move abroad, we opted for IVF.

Thanks to her exceptional expertise and guidance, we succeeded in our very first IVF attempt. Throughout my pregnancy, Dr. Aishwarya provided outstanding care, always prioritizing the well-being of both me and my baby. Even when I faced challenges like dengue fever during pregnancy, she was vigilant and proactive, ensuring that we both remained healthy.

Her constant availability, immediate responses, and swift actions gave us immense comfort and trust throughout this journey. Finally, I delivered my beautiful baby girl via a successful C-section performed by Dr. Aishwarya, and both of us are now doing well.

I also want to extend my heartfelt thanks to Dr. Ashwin for conducting all the necessary scans and providing accurate reports, which played a crucial role in my journey. Additionally, the entire ASCAS staff was incredibly kind and attentive, making each hospital visit smooth and stress-free.

Thank you, Dr. Aishwarya, for your expertise, care, and unwavering support. You have been a blessing in our lives!

Warm Regards
Sonia & Rajkumar

reviews.author: Karthika M.S
reviews.text:
I am writing to express my heartfelt gratitude for your unwavering support and guidance throughout my fertility journey. After six failed IUIs and 9 years into this journey, I came to when we almost lost hope and your positivity made all the difference. Now we are blessed with twins.

I was skeptical when I was told our only option left was IVF. Your expertise and explanations made me comfortable. It was definitely a long journey and I was worried when I heard that even after extracting over 20 eggs their quality was very less. Though I failed to conceive with the best quality egg in the first cycle, you gave me hope during one of the most disheartening times of my life. In the second cycle, your meticulous care, including the use of laser-assisted hatching and embryo glue, along with your positive and encouraging approach, led to the successful conception of twins, even with a C-grade embryo.

Throughout my pregnancy, your dedicated care ensured a safe and smooth journey. I must have bugged you in whatsapp multiple times but you were always there. From tailoring a specific treatment plan with supporting injection dosages to ensuring I don't end up in miscarriage with precautionary stitches (OST), regular follow-up scans everything was seamless and appreciate your attention to detail.

I would also like to extend my gratitude to Dr.Ashwin for his patience and thorough explanations after each scan, which helped ease my concerns. The friendly and caring staff at ASCAS made every visit comforting, and their kindness did not go unnoticed.

I wholeheartedly recommend ASCAS and you, Dr. Aishwarya, as the best fertility doctor I have consulted in past 10 years. Thank you for making our dream of parenthood a reality.

reviews.author: Sharmila
reviews.text:
Heartfelt Gratitude to Dr. Aishwarya

For three years, we underwent treatment for irregular menstruation, believing it was the cause of our infertility. Despite visiting two hospitals, we couldn’t find a solution and were completely losing hope. When we consulted Dr. Aishwarya, she conducted a thorough evaluation and discovered that the actual root cause was male infertility – severe oligoasthenoteratozoospermia.

Dr. Aishwarya’s strong network of experts played a crucial role in our journey. With her top connections to advanced laboratories, genetic counseling specialists, and skilled andrologists, she left no stone unturned in diagnosing and addressing the problem. She also performed karyotyping, which revealed a chromosomal dislocation.

When we felt completely hopeless, Dr. Aishwarya gave us the confidence to move forward. Through her expert guidance and IVF treatment, by God’s grace, we achieved a positive result on the very first attempt.

We are deeply grateful to Dr. Aishwarya for her expertise, compassionate care, and seamless coordination with other specialists. She is truly a blessing, and we will always hold her in the highest regard!

reviews.author: swathi divakar
reviews.text:
I am deeply grateful to Dr. Aishwarya and for her exceptional guidance and quality treatment. We consulted her for severe endometriosis, and from day one, she was transparent and clear in adopting appropriate treatment strategies. I am writing this detailed review to help others who may need her guidance and benefit from her outstanding professional expertise. Accumed is one stop solution with in house scans, lab and pharmacy. Highly recommend Accumed for all fertility and gynecological problems

I consulted Dr. Aishwarya for severe endometriosis. She explained the pros and cons of the condition and outlined the possible treatment options in a clear and concise manner. As she highlighted, my AMH was very low (0.35), so she recommended a dual stimulation protocol, which worked exceptionally well for us. Despite my low AMH levels, we managed to obtain a few embryos, one of which successfully resulted in a pregnancy, and I delivered a healthy baby boy.
Aishwarya is highly professional, empathetic, and always accessible to her patients, even over the phone, to address queries or concerns during fertility treatment. Very much grateful for having met her for our fertility problems.

reviews.author: Priscilla Jazz
reviews.text: I have been trying for pregnancy for more than a year. I reached out to Dr.Aishwarya mam for the treatment.  She suggested to take MRI pelvis to identify the issue where I was diagnosed with septate uterus. I have no idea and we were completely blank and unaware of it. She guided us and explained the procedure called laparoscopic hysteroscopy in which the septum will be removed completely, and cost of the procedure is also fair. We followed her instructions and finally we came up with the successful result. We thank her soulfully for her support and guidance.
